role: Engineering comparison and sensitivity baseline, legal on the fixture as rounded: the raw centres rounded to the nearest 0.5 mm, rotations kept, no repair moves. It is not the paper's layout, never a paper match, and not part of gate zero.
rounding_rule: Each centre coordinate c becomes 0.5 * floor(c / 0.5 + 0.5): the nearest multiple of 0.5 mm. An exact tie (c / 0.5 ends in .5) rounds up, toward +infinity. Rotations are kept. No repair moves.

wire_note: routed_wirelength is this layout's routed wire W, from the open router (TAP-2.5D's MILP router ported from CPLEX to HiGHS), the wire figure the challenge judges. It depends only on the dies' relative positions: moving the whole layout leaves it unchanged. wire_proxy_mm is the proxy W_proxy, the connectivity-weighted mean Manhattan distance between die centres, a diagnostic that is never used to judge. Neither runs a thermal solve.
